(wi.) adipadena sanvadaDikyayo grahanan vitanqayan parajayakaranan prasangat vitanqayan nigrahadikan atidisati kaTalaksanan .vitanqayan nyayo jalpavadirita vitanqayan ca ityetavata purne yat aDikanupadate tena jalpe yavat paro jita ityuktapravrtiprakaraparyavasanayorapi atideso laByate anyaTaprakrtatvatnigrahasTananatratideso vijnayeta tatasca svapaksasTapanan vina jalpavadeva vitanqa ityuktan Bavati jalpavitanqayo parajitasya krtyan viroDadi praptavato jalpavitanqayo ki karya : ityapeksayan aha kaTalaksanan sanvade danqayata na syat vitanqajalpayorapi 20 parajitatvanatrasyat…. viroDadisu praptanigrahasTanavisaye vitanqayan jalpe ca yadi vadi prativadi va sanvadan kurute tada nasO saBapatina danqya kintu : Kanqitahankarataya apananavisaya eva syat jalpavitanqayo praptatigrahasTananangikartu kartavyan yadi agrahavasat praptepi dose na sanvadan karoti tatraha kaTalaksanan …nindyo danqyopi vanyaTa vasabdo dosataratanyena nindadanqayo vyavasTitaviBasayan vartate apisabdo danqepi nindasanucaye kaTalaksanapancika (wi.) vadiprativadino nigrahasTanacintaprasangat prasnikaparaDan apohanuKena sucayati kaTalaksanan anuvadadirahitya nEva jalpepi dusanan 21 evakari hetu sucanarTa eke nanyante, prasnikE vayuktasya prativadinan prati, prativadyuktasya ca vadinan prati anuvada karaniya apratibudDO ca vadiprativadinO boDaniyO tadakarane tesan aparaDa iti tadetat jalpe vitanqayanapi anuvadadirahityan prasnikanan na dusanan anuvadadyaBavepi vadiprativadiByan jalpavitanqayo pravartayitun sakyatvena tasya tadakarnatvat kin nana : praguktasvakarnananusWananeva prasnikanan aparaDa iti natantaranirasaya apoha iti jnatavyan Endragnent
ck: katalaksanapancika (ti.) calpe ca yavat paro cita ityuktan tatra calpe ka paracayahetu ityapeksayan aha katalaksanan virotasankatinyunatusninpavatikEcita 19 pavecalpe. (ti.) atipatena sanvatatikyayo krahanan vitantayan paracayakaranan prasankat vitantayan nikrahatikan atitisati katalaksanan .vitantayan nyayo calpavatirita vitantayan ca ityetavata purne yat atikanupatate tena calpe yavat paro cita ityuktapravrtiprakaraparyavasanayorapi atiteso lapyate anyataprakrtatvatnikrahastananatratiteso vicnayeta tatasca svapaksastapanan vina calpavateva vitanta ityuktan pavati calpavitantayo paracitasya krtyan virotati praptavato calpavitantayo ki karya : ityapeksayan aha katalaksanan sanvate tantayata na syat vitantacalpayorapi 20 paracitatvanatrasyat…. virotatisu praptanikrahastanavisaye vitantayan calpe ca yati vati prativati va sanvatan kurute tata nasO sapapatina tantya kintu : kantitahankarataya apananavisaya eva syat calpavitantayo praptatikrahastananankikartu kartavyan yati akrahavasat praptepi tose na sanvatan karoti tatraha katalaksanan …nintyo tantyopi vanyata vasapto tosataratanyena nintatantayo vyavastitavipasayan vartate apisapto tantepi nintasanucaye katalaksanapancika (ti.) vatiprativatino nikrahastanacintaprasankat prasnikaparatan apohanukena sucayati katalaksanan anuvatatirahitya nEva calpepi tusanan 21 evakari hetu sucanarta eke nanyante, prasnikE vayuktasya prativatinan prati, prativatyuktasya ca vatinan prati anuvata karaniya apratiputO ca vatiprativatinO potaniyO tatakarane tesan aparata iti tatetat calpe vitantayanapi anuvatatirahityan prasnikanan na tusanan anuvatatyapavepi vatiprativatipyan calpavitantayo pravartayitun sakyatvena tasya tatakarnatvat kin nana : prakuktasvakarnananustananeva prasnikanan aparata iti natantaranirasaya apoha iti cnatavyan Entraknent

pk: kaTalaksanapancika (wi.) nanu viroDadivyatiriktani hetvaBasadini nigrahasTanani santi vijayanatra- prayojanayosca jalpavitanqayo parajayaninitani sanBavitani ca ata kaTan viroDadisawkenEva jalpasdO parajaya ityata aha kaTalaksanan tadaBavat nEva sawkat anyo nigraha isyate 2 antarBavatihanyesanigrahanan. anyesan viroDadipadE agrhitataya tatonyatvena sankitanan hetvaBasadinan iha sawke antarBavat, pawkanantarButanan ca asrayasidDyadinan tadaBavat nigrahasTanatvaBavat, jalpavitanqayo sawkadanyanigrahasTananangikaro na dosaya iti kaTan hetvaBasadinan etesvantarBava ? kaTan ca anantarButanan anigrahasTanatvan ? ityata aha kaTalaksanan .iti sna ha uktaparanarsa itisabda sna ha iti nipatO suprasidDin dyotayata hetvaBasadinan viroDadisu antarBava, anantarButanan ca anigrahasTanatvan viroDadinan hetvaBasadinan ca svarupayaTatnyajnane sati sujnananeva iti kin tatra yatnena ? iti vidyapariksapurvEvajalpavitanqapravrti kaTata purvan vidyahinatvalingena parajaya ityuktan, tana kaTanantarena vidyahinatvalingasya apratite ityata:aha kaTalaksanan vidyapariksapurvEva vrtirjalpavitanqayo 23 kaTalaksanapancika (wi.) jalpavitanqaDikarino Kalu vidyahinatvalingena kaTata prak parajaya isyate jalpa- vitanqapravrtisca vidyapariksapurveva vidyapariksa ca vadenEva vade ca na sanBavitasanana- vidyatvapeksa evan ca vidyapariksaya vidyahinatvanisvayat na viroDa vidyasanye tu jalpavitanqe iti apasnaradina praptananapi viroDadinan na parajayahetutvan viroDasdini nigrahasTanani ityuktan tatra visesa aha kaTalaksanan sKalitatvadinatrena na tatrapi parajaya tatra jalpavitanqayorapi sKalanena apasnaradivasena va praptE viroDadiBi na parajayo nantavya, apawukaranatvadina sanBavata sKalanade pratiyogyapeksaya apakarsasya adyotakatvat kinu vadakaTayan iti kaTalaksanapancika (wi.) tatra vade caturDa nigrahasTanagati kincit asanBavitaneva, yaTa pratijnahani pratijnasanyaso nirarTakan arTantaran avijnatarTan aparTakan iti sawkan esan asaktisangrahana- prakaratvat tatvavuButsutaya ca vade tadaBavat pranadat sanBavepi udBavya tyajaniyani kincit sanBavadapi anudBavyaneva, yaTa pratijnantaran hetvantaran ajnanan apratiBa viksepa natanujna paryanuyojyopeksanan iti saptakan etadudBavananudBavanayo tatvanirnayanugunyavEgunyaBavat kiscit udBavyanatran, yaTa viroDa apraptakalan nyunan aDikan punaruktan ananuBasanan apasidDanta iti saptakan kincit kaTavasanikan, yaTahetvaBaso niranuyojyanuyoga iti dvayan kaTalaksanapancika (wi.) tatvanirnayasya hi saksat virudDa viparitapratipati, sa ca hetvaBasadyanudBava
